settings.title: Who is this for?
settings.content:
• Individuals looking to address signs of aging, such as fine lines and wrinkles, in specific facial areas.
  • Users of MyoLift™ microcurrent devices seeking a convenient and effective treatment.
  • Those preferring a hands-free, no-mess solution for facial toning.
  • Not recommended for individuals who have a history of skin reactions to adhesives.

settings.title: What is included?
settings.content:
• 1 x Conductive Forehead Mask
  • 1 x Conductive Eye Mask
  • 1 x Conductive Lip Mask
  • 1 x Conductive Jowl Mask
  • 1 x Conductive Neck Mask

settings.title: Benefits
settings.content:
• Reduces Fine Lines and Wrinkles: Targets aging signs on the forehead, around the eyes, lips, jowls, and neck.
  • Stimulates Collagen and Elastin Production: Enhances skin elasticity and firmness.
  • Improves Skin Tone and Texture: Promotes a smoother and more youthful complexion.
  • Convenient and Easy to Use: No messy gels or creams required.
  • Cost-Effective: Reusable design offers multiple treatments per mask.

settings.title: Product Features
settings.content:
• Hands-Free Design: Allows for multitasking during treatment sessions.
  • Reusable: Each mask can be used for 10–12 treatments.
  • No Conductive Gel Required: Simplifies the treatment process.
  • Compatible with MyoLift™ Devices: Designed to work seamlessly with MyoLift™ QT Plus and MyoLift™ Mini.
  • Portable and Convenient: Ideal for home use or travel.

settings.section_content:
1. Cleanse Skin: Ensure the forehead, eye, lip, jowl, and neck areas are clean and free from oils or makeup.
  2. Apply Conductive Serum: Lightly spritz the areas with Replenish Spritzer or apply a water-based serum. Avoid oil-based products.
  3. Peel Backing: Carefully peel the plastic backing from each mask.
  4. Position Masks: Place the forehead mask on the forehead, the eye mask over the eyes, the lip mask over the lips, the jowl mask over the jowls, and the neck mask over the neck, ensuring proper contact with the skin.
  5. Connect to Device: Attach the masks to your MyoLift™ device using the provided lead wire splitters.
  6. Select Settings: Use the Educate or Erase setting on your device, adjusting the frequency as needed.
  7. Treatment Duration: Apply for 10–30 minutes, dividing the time between the Educate and Erase settings.
  8. Post-Treatment Care: Remove the masks, clean any residue, and store them in a sealed bag for future use.

settings.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
settings.title1: How does the ReNu Conductive Tx Gel work with microcurrent treatments?
settings.text1: The gel acts as a conductive agent, allowing microcurrent energy to penetrate the skin more effectively during treatment. It improves the current's ability to stimulate collagen production, increase skin elasticity, and hydrate the skin deeply.
settings.title2: Can I use the ReNu Conductive Tx Gel without a microcurrent device?
settings.text2: Yes, while the gel is specifically designed for use with microcurrent devices, you can also use it on its own as a hydrating treatment for dry skin. It provides deep moisture and improves skin texture without needing a device.
settings.title3: Is the ReNu Conductive Tx Gel suitable for all skin types?
settings.text3: The gel is formulated for dry skin but can be used on all skin types, especially for those needing extra hydration. It is gentle enough for sensitive skin and helps restore moisture without causing irritation.
settings.title4: How often should I use the ReNu Conductive Tx Gel?
settings.text4: For microcurrent treatments, apply the gel each time you use the device. For daily use, you can apply it once or twice a day as part of your regular skincare routine to keep your skin hydrated and smooth.
settings.title5: What are the key benefits of using the ReNu Conductive Tx Gel?
settings.text5:
• Enhances microcurrent conductivity for more effective treatments.
  • Deeply hydrates and replenishes moisture in dry skin.
  • Improves skin texture and elasticity over time.
  • Supports overall skin health with a nourishing Bio-Active Complex.
